# Summary of the class 

Topics convered. 

- How to develop a research question/Topics
- Functional form: $Y = f(x)$, or in a multivariate setup $Y = f(x_1, x_2, ... , x_n). Students will be asked to show $Y$ and some $x$s for their research topic. 
- Reserach ideas
- Examples
- Operational definition of the main topic/theme of the topic. 
- Descriptive statistics
- Hypothesis testing: t-test and p values
